comment: Required checks gate a DEPLOY_SHA (check-sha-green). The required list equals the jobs that run on every push to dev or to a releases-* branch, minus the optional and exempt entries, each of which carries a reason. A deploy sha is a dev commit, and the release flow pushes a releases-* branch at it, so it carries both push runs. scripts/ci/deploy-gate-jobs.ts derives that set from .github/workflows, and check-sha-green.test.ts fails on any gap (QA plan v1 T4). A draft skip or a pull_request path filter does not take a job out, because neither applies to a push. A push path filter does, except the docs-only paths-ignore (**.md, **.txt): a docs-only sha does not run those suites, so it is never green; tag a code commit. A matrix job is a prefix entry. A required entry needs a check-run with that exact name (or a name starting with prefix), and every run of that name must have concluded success. smoke-test-twin-publish and smoke-test-twin-pause-all (suite 14) are class required-on-deploy-paths: they run on every push, so a DEPLOY_SHA always carries them, and on a pull request only when a path in the paths list changed (the smoke-test-changes filter). Optional entries are reported and never change the exit code. Exempt entries run on every push, test nothing about the sha and are never read by check-sha-green. core-stages-twin-upgrade-lifecycle (issue 1811) is required although it skips on a draft pull request: it runs on every push to dev, so a DEPLOY_SHA always carries it, and every core stage deploys a governed proxy and the freeze is irreversible, so no release may deploy from a sha whose Twin rehearsal of the governed upgrade, freeze and refused post-freeze upgrade did not pass. It is required although it forks the same rate-limited Base upstream (BASE_UPSTREAM_RPC) that keeps core-stages-twin-chain off the required list: core-stages-twin-chain is optional here, and is gated indirectly through the frozen counts green-conclusion rule, while this job is gated directly here. An upstream outage is recovered by re-running the failed job: check-sha-green lists check-runs with filter=latest, so a successful re-run supersedes the failed attempt. core-stages-twin-upgrade-from-v050 (issue 1927) is required on the same terms: it skips only on a draft pull request, and it is the only rehearsal of the governed upgrade of the live v0.5.0 deployment from a real v0.5.0 build (runbook 4.15), so no rc of the line may cut from a sha whose rehearsal did not pass.

optional.name: forge-fork-vault-regressions
optional.reason: It runs on the Twin chain, a pinned lazy fork of real Base state served by a public upstream that can rate limit (core 1498), so a provider outage must not block a deploy sha.
Suite 5 legs on the Twin chain and anvil. Optional since the list was created (core 1505), next to forge-fork-vault-regressions, which reads the same public upstream.

optional.name: base-testnet-adapters
optional.reason: Suite 5 leg that needs the Base testnet RPC and a funded testnet account from repository secrets. A testnet outage or an empty funder must not block a deploy sha. Kept with fork-integration-*.

optional.name: core-stages-twin-chain
optional.reason: It reads a public Base upstream that can rate limit, so a required entry would block every deploy sha on a provider outage. It is gated indirectly: freeze-counts refuses a counts file whose rehearsal conclusion is not success, and the plan job needs the committed counts. core-stages-twin-upgrade-lifecycle reads the same upstream and is gated directly (issue 1846).

optional.name: solidity-slither
optional.reason: It installs the latest slither-analyzer from pip with no version pin, so a new detector release can turn it red with no change in the sha.

optional.name: skill-url-reachability
optional.reason: It fetches the published raw SKILL.md URLs of the dev ref over the live network, not this sha's files (CI_CLASS heavy, a sweep).

optional.name: opencode-headless-deposit-replay
optional.reason: Suite 11b has no push trigger: it runs on the nightly and on dispatch, so a deploy sha does not always carry it.

exempt.name: twin-pin
exempt.reason: It chooses the Twin chain pin block for its workflow and tests nothing. Every Twin chain job needs it, so a failed pin skips them, and a skipped required job fails the gate.

exempt.name: smoke-test-changes
exempt.reason: It computes the suite 14 deploy-path flag and tests nothing. On a push it always sets deploy=true, so both required-on-deploy-paths jobs run.

exempt.name: dispatch-full-suite
exempt.reason: It dispatches the workflow_dispatch suites against a release or qa commit and then runs check-sha-green as the authority. It tests nothing itself, and it cannot gate the sha it is still working on.
